<?php
// E2E probe (test only): reports the stored gateway settings that matter to the 3D Secure setting test.
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) || 'opt' !== $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	$s = get_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', array() );
	echo wp_json_encode( array( 'has_3ds_key' => array_key_exists( 'enable_3ds', $s ), 'enable_3ds' => $s['enable_3ds'] ?? null, 'test_mode' => $s['test_mode'] ?? null, 'enable_apple_pay' => $s['enable_apple_pay'] ?? null ) );
	exit;
} );
